newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say October growth slower.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say October growth slower.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management in its October report showed the recovery continuing but more slowly than in September, the group said Thursday.
"We now have two months of data indicating that the rate of recovery is not accelerating," it said.
Employment continued to increase at a rate similar to September's but the local labor market remained tight, the group said. Commodity prices were stable but equipment and service prices rose.
